why: pins implementation details of the comparators and populations that the protocol named but did not parameterise; registered after the data contract and engine code exist and before any B2 score is computed

comparator_formulas_on_v2_data.history: same-season appearances of the player (any team) in games with start <= target_start - (horizon + 210) min; eligibility: >=5 such appearances and mean TOI of the last 3 >= 480 s
simple: season_rate_x_prior3_toi (sum SOG / sum TOI hours) x mean TOI of last 3 / 3600
comparator_formulas_on_v2_data.human: expected TOI (mean of last 3) / 3600 x shrunk rate x opponent factor; shrunk rate = (prior SOG + r0*h0)/(prior TOI hours + h0), r0 and the mean TOI hours per game from FIT 2018-2022 eligible rows that played (position groups F=C/L/R, D), h0 = 20 x that mean TOI hours; opponent factor = 1 + 0.5*(opponent season-to-date SOG allowed per game / league season-to-date SOG per team-game - 1), 1 if unavailable (league needs >=60 team-games)
comparator_formulas_on_v2_data.distribution: Poisson with the baseline mean floored at 0.05 for distribution scoring only (central metrics use the unfloored mean)

identical_rows: a comparison between forecasts uses exactly the rows for which every compared forecast exists (B2 candidate row AND comparator-eligible); populations reported: FULL candidate universe, MEANINGFUL expected participants, each intersected with comparator eligibility
base_rate_comparator_for_brier_skill: FIT 2018-2022 event rate P(SOG>=k) by position class (F, D, U->global), computed within the same population definition (FULL or MEANINGFUL) as the rows being scored
production_classifier_comparison: phase0_error_receipts p_served for market skater_sog_ge3 (seasons 2024, 2025) joined to V2 rows on (game_id, player_id); only players who played exist in that ledger, so the comparison is restricted to played rows and compares B2's unconditional P(SOG>=3) (which includes participation uncertainty) with the classifier's conditional-on-playing probability; the comparison is therefore biased toward the classifier and is reported descriptively; no central comparison
burned_reproduction_populations: full population n must equal 60279 for the 2025 reproduction check; MEANINGFUL and played-only are additional descriptive views
calibration_tables: 10 equal-count bins per threshold, reported for FULL and MEANINGFUL
numerical: scipy nbinom / poisson closed forms; K extended per 20000-row chunk until survival < 1e-10 (ceiling 200); NLL floor 1e-15 with floor hits reported
